Row.Text: A toolkit of multiplayer quality-of-life features for Civilization VII: a fully synchronized pause (any player pauses, everyone readies or the host resumes for all, with a countdown and an automatic pause when a player disconnects), a Competitive turn timer that scales with each empire, competitive Game Balance changes, new multiplayer maps with East vs West player placement and a resource list with every resource in every Age, a Match Type for Free for All and team matches, Pace and Gameplay settings, multiplayer keybinds, and lobby fixes. Everything applies to multiplayer games only.
